entities.summary: Karakum Desert, a notable figure in the history of Turkmenistan, associated with Soviet Turkmenistan (1917–1936). Preceded by Russian Revolution and Junaid Khan leads Basmachi resistance in the Karakum Desert into the 1930s. Their legacy influenced Turkmen SSR created as a Soviet republic and Karakum Canal and Cotton Economy.
